policy.crown007_rule: Keep Crown stable as the quality reference, allow opportunistic/shared-fleet improvements, but do not let Crown polish block getting the rest of the roster into production.
policy.beta1_requirement: use all recoverable Beta1 vehicle/part/material sources
policy.beta2_requirement: for every active vehicle, search Car Parking Multiplayer and Real Racing 3 before promotion
policy.selection: do not stop at first usable source; combine strongest compatible body/interior/wheels/materials/LOD/damage parts across Beta1 and Beta2

batch_rule.parallelism: process identities in batches rather than finishing one vehicle before inspecting the rest
batch_rule.primary_goal: get the other cars to at least the current Crown007 quality band while preserving Android budgets
per_vehicle_steps: collect all Beta1 matching variants and parts
search Beta2 Car Parking catalog/bundles for exact or compatible identity/components
search Beta2 Real Racing 3 inventory for exact or compatible identity/components
compare body geometry, interior, wheels, tyres, glass, lamps, materials, textures, LODs and damage parts
select strongest compatible cross-beta component set with provenance
author only the missing production pieces
validate LOD0-LOD3 and Android budgets independently
defer runtime integration to the main optimization lane

identity_rules.ToyotaCrown: accepted current state; not permanently complete; not primary focus
identity_rules.Porsche: excluded from all extraction, reconstruction, branding and promotion
identity_rules.unresolved: must pass identity gate before media promotion
